customer: Good afternoon, I'm hoping to get my coupe appraised at one of your stores here in North Carolina this week. Do I need to schedule an appointment first, and how long should I plan to be there? I'd also like to know how long the quote stays good, since I may want a few days to think it over. Thank you for your help.
agent: Thank you for reaching out! No appointment is needed. You can walk into any Northwind store, and a specialist will inspect your coupe while you wait, usually in 30 to 45 minutes, then give you a written quote that's valid for 7 days or 300 miles. If you decide to accept during that visit, you can finish the sale right then, so it helps to bring your photo ID, registration and title, or your payoff information if you still have a loan.
